## Overview

Approved files are distributed through **datalibweb**, in two collections:

| Collection | Content |
|---|---|
| `FDPRAW` | Raw survey microdata, questionnaires and documentation |
| `FDP` | Harmonized microdata (50by35 schema) and harmonization programs |

The harmonized welfare module in the `FDP` collection is called **`WELF`**.

## Who can access data
To access the data, users must be registered on datalibweb and have permission to access the `FDPRAW` and `FDP` collections. Access is set to private by default on datalibweb. Each user needs to subscribe to access the datasets they need and be approved by admin. Admin can change access to public, so that all (internal) datalibweb users can access it without user level subscription. 

## File naming conventions

datalibweb survey identifiers guarantee replicability: versions are **never replaced** — new releases get a new version number, and previous vintages remain available. Always record the full survey ID used in an analysis.

**Raw (master) data** in `FDPRAW`:

```
CCC_YYYY_SSSS_V##_M
```

- `CCC` — 3-letter ISO/WDI country code (e.g. `COL`)
- `YYYY` — year data collection started
- `SSSS` — survey acronym (e.g. `GEIH`, `EHCVM`, `RHS`)
- `V##_M` — version of the **master** (original) data; first release is `V01`

**Harmonized data** in `FDP`:

```
CCC_YYYY_SSSS_V##_M_V##_A_FDP
```

- `V##_A` — version of the harmonization (**adaptation**), independent of the master version
- `FDP` — the collection of harmonized surveys

**Module files** append the module name to the survey ID. The 50by35 harmonized welfare file (V01) for Colombia is:

```
COL_2023_GEIH_V01_M_V01_A_FDP_WELF.dta
```

## Using datalibweb
Two clients are available: the [`datalibweb` Stata package](https://github.com/worldbank/datalibweb) and the [`dlw` R package](https://github.com/worldbank/dlw). Both require the World Bank intranet/VPN, permission to access the collections, and the same datalibweb token used by PRIMUS (valid 30 days, renewed on the datalibweb website).

### Authentication

Tokens are valid for 30 days. Renew them on the [datalibweb website](https://datalibweb2.worldbank.org). Do not commit tokens or put them in scripts.

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## R

```r
dlw_set_token("<your datalibweb token>")   # one-time setup; stored in the system keychain
```

R reuses the saved token; run `dlw_set_token()` again only after renewal.

## Stata

```stata
datalibweb, token(<your datalibweb token>) version(2)
* one-time setup; do not hard-code it in a do-file.
```

:::


## Checking the catalog

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## R

```r
library(dlw)

# all collections (servers) you can access
dlw_server_catalog()

# what is in a collection
dlw_server_catalog("FDP")
dlw_server_catalog("FDPRAW")

# everything available for one country, across collections
dlw_country_catalog("COL")

# files for one country within a collection
dlw_server_inventory("COL", server = "FDP")
```

## Stata

```stata
* interactive browser: click through region -> country -> collection
datalibweb

* list what is available for a country-year in a collection; when raw
* data is requested, datalibweb lists the individual files to pick from
datalibweb, country(COL) years(2023) type(FDP) clear
```

:::

## Loading data

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## R

```r
library(dlw)

# harmonized 50by35 welfare module (WELF) from the FDP collection

welf <- dlw_get_data(
  country_code = "COL",
  filename     = "COL_2023_GEIH_V01_M_V01_A_FDP_WELF.dta",
  server       = "FDP",
  year         = 2023
)

# a raw file from the FDPRAW collection; year and survey (acronym) disambiguate
# the specific survey vintage — the R equivalent of Stata's surveyid()
raw <- dlw_get_data(
  country_code = "COL",
  year         = 2023,
  survey       = "GEIH",
  filename     = "individual_data_2023.dta",
  server       = "FDP"
)

```

## Stata

```stata
* harmonized 50by35 welfare module (WELF) from the FDP collection;
* the latest master and harmonization versions are loaded by default
datalibweb, country(COL) years(2023) type(FDP) mod(WELF) clear

* pin specific vintages for replicability
dlw, country(COL) years(2023) type(FDP) mod(WELF) verm(01) vera(01) survey(GEIH) clear

* a raw file from the FDPRAW collection
datalibweb, country(COL) years(2023) type(FDPRAW) ///
    surveyid(COL_2023_GEIH_V01_M) filename(individual_data_2023.dta) clear

```

:::

## Calculating SR indicators

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

## R

```r
library(dlw)
source("R/utils.R")   # dlw_support_tables(), dlw_cpi_ppp(); run from the repository root

# harmonized 50by35 welfare module (WELF) from the FDP collection

welf <- dlw_get_data(
  country_code = "COL",
  filename     = "COL_2023_GEIH_V01_M_V01_A_FDP_WELF.dta",
  server       = "FDP",
  year         = 2023
)

# calculate SR indicator ----

ccode <- welf$code[1]
yr    <- welf$year[1]

# CPI and PPP from the latest datalibweb Support files (2021 framework):
# CPI is the survey-year CPI relative to 2021 (1 in 2021); PPP is the ICP 2021
# conversion factor (LCU per international $).
fx <- dlw_cpi_ppp(dlw_support_tables(), ccode, yr)
cpi_value <- fx$cpi
ppp_value <- fx$ppp

# poverty line in $/day 2021 PPP (placeholder — pending confirmation)
zline <- 3.00

# self-reliance share: weighted proportion above the line using welfare_self
sr_share <- weighted.mean(
  welf$welfare_self / 365 / cpi_value / ppp_value >= zline,
  welf$weight
)

# poverty headcount: weighted proportion below the line using welfare
headcount <- weighted.mean(
  welf$welfare / 365 / cpi_value / ppp_value < zline,
  welf$weight
)

sprintf("%s %d - Self-reliance share: %.4f  Headcount: %.4f ($%.2f/day 2021PPP)", ccode, yr, sr_share, headcount, zline)

# primary indicator: national poverty line, if natpovline is in the file.
# natpovline shares welfare's annual per capita LCU basis, so no CPI/PPP.
if ("natpovline" %in% names(welf)) {
  sr_share_nat <- weighted.mean(welf$welfare_self >= welf$natpovline, welf$weight)
  headcount_nat <- weighted.mean(welf$welfare < welf$natpovline, welf$weight)
  sprintf("National line - Self-reliance share (primary): %.4f  Headcount: %.4f",
          sr_share_nat, headcount_nat)
}

# by camp status (camp may be missing for every row, e.g. in COL)
camp <- as.integer(welf$camp)
for (l in sort(unique(camp[!is.na(camp)]))) {
  g <- welf[camp %in% l, ]
  print(sprintf("camp==%d - Self-reliance share ($%.2f/day): %.4f", l, zline,
                weighted.mean(g$welfare_self / 365 / cpi_value / ppp_value >= zline, g$weight)))
  if ("natpovline" %in% names(g))
    print(sprintf("camp==%d - Self-reliance share (national line): %.4f", l,
                  weighted.mean(g$welfare_self >= g$natpovline, g$weight)))
}
```

## Stata

```stata
* harmonized 50by35 welfare module (WELF) from the FDP collection;
* the latest master and harmonization versions are loaded by default
datalibweb, country(COL) years(2023) type(FDP) mod(WELF) clear

* calculate SR indicator
local ccode = code[1]
local year  = year[1]

* CPI and PPP from the latest datalibweb Support files (2021 framework):
* CPI is the survey-year CPI relative to 2021 (1 in 2021); PPP is the ICP 2021
* conversion factor (LCU per international $). Needs the datalibweb token set
* in Stata; run from the repository root.
do "Stata/utils.do"
dlw_cpi_ppp, country(`ccode') year(`year')
local cpival = r(cpi)
local pppval = r(ppp)

* poverty line in $/day 2021 PPP (placeholder — pending confirmation)
local zline 3.00

* self-reliance share: weighted proportion above the line using welfare_self
gen byte _sr = (welfare_self/365/`cpival'/`pppval') >= `zline'
qui sum _sr [aw=weight]
local sr : di %9.6f r(mean)

* poverty headcount: weighted proportion below the line using welfare
gen byte _poor = (welfare/365/`cpival'/`pppval') < `zline'
qui sum _poor [aw=weight]
local hc : di %9.6f r(mean)

drop _sr _poor
di "`ccode' `year' - Self-reliance share: `sr'  Headcount: `hc' ($`zline'/day 2021PPP)"

* primary indicator: national poverty line, if natpovline is in the file.
* natpovline shares welfare's annual per capita LCU basis, so no CPI/PPP.
capture confirm variable natpovline
if !_rc {
    gen byte _sr_nat = welfare_self >= natpovline
    qui sum _sr_nat [aw=weight]
    di "National line - Self-reliance share (primary): " %9.6f r(mean)
    gen byte _poor_nat = welfare < natpovline
    qui sum _poor_nat [aw=weight]
    di "National line - Headcount: " %9.6f r(mean)
}

* by camp status (camp may be missing for every row, e.g. in COL)
gen byte _sr = (welfare_self/365/`cpival'/`pppval') >= `zline'
capture confirm variable _sr_nat
local hasnat = !_rc
qui levelsof camp, local(camplevels)
foreach l of local camplevels {
    qui sum _sr if camp==`l' [aw=weight]
    di "camp==`l' - Self-reliance share ($`zline'/day): " %9.6f r(mean)
    if `hasnat' {
        qui sum _sr_nat if camp==`l' [aw=weight]
        di "camp==`l' - Self-reliance share (national line): " %9.6f r(mean)
    }
}
capture drop _sr _sr_nat _poor_nat
```

:::
